verdict.rationale: Zapier advertises a Workflow API for powering built-in automation experiences and AI workflows, and its embed offering lets customers build workflows inside a host product. This implies programmatic workflow creation, but no evidence documents API endpoints for an agent to create, update, and activate a Zap. The SDK, MCP and stored-actions material only covers executing individual actions, not managing workflows. Missing for 10: documented create/update/activate workflow endpoints, explicit agent-driven workflow management, an OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
